method: One command per cell; two independent same-version workers for ResNet-50/BERT/GPT-2, one interpreter for SmolLM2. Pre-frozen inputs exclude download/capture. Separate per-side compiler caches start empty and warm across batches. This final series runs sequentially without another Faultline measurement campaign, following a host OOM in the previous overlapping series. The host is otherwise uncontrolled; wall times are operational measurements, not isolated performance benchmarks. RSS is the maximum sampled worker process-tree RSS, not total system memory or VRAM.

comparator.timing_scope: One million equal float32 values, CPU, one thread, seven calls; not a model-level speedup claim.

bert_primary.note: New fresh worker; copied warm compiler cache, same frozen batch/settings/interpreter. Concurrent host workloads differ. This is not a full-preset cost measurement.

bert_diagnostic.note: Fresh diagnostic worker; same frozen batch/settings/interpreter, copied warm compiler cache. Concurrent host workloads differ; not a full-preset cost measurement.

smollm2_full_check.scope: Before and after optimization, same frozen ten batches and interpreter. Timing and source provenance differ and are not asserted equal.

preoptimization.scope: Six completed cells from the preceding implementation. BERT thorough was stopped after two committed batches once equivalence checks supported restarting the full cost study. All 48 prior batch commits and incomplete artifacts were retained. These cells are not pooled with the final ten.

interrupted_optimized_series.cause: Kernel global OOM during overlap with the full upgrade campaign; all 139 completed batch commits across the two campaigns verified unchanged.
interrupted_optimized_series.timing: The interrupted series is excluded from completed cell costs. Every final cost cell starts fresh; the original upgrade campaign resumes with unchanged identity.

wall_time_fields: outer_wall_s includes interpreter startup and is used for final cost tables. command_wall_s is the CLI measurement starting after imports. Both are retained. Preoptimization tables reported command_wall_s.
workload_scope: Metadata describes the prepared ten-batch input collections. Quick uses their first three batches; standard and thorough use all ten. Text models return last_hidden_state. Model weights are float32.
